domains.title: Number foundations
domains.prep: Start with fraction equivalence, signed numbers, and order of operations.

domains.title: Ratios and percents
domains.prep: Practice unit rates, proportions, and percent change.
domains.example: A $40 item discounted 25% saves 0.25 × 40 = $10. The sale price is $30.

domains.title: Linear equations and models
domains.prep: Practice equations, slope, and comparing linear models.
domains.example: Solve 3x + 5 = 20: subtract 5 to get 3x = 15; divide by 3 to get x = 5. Check: 3(5) + 5 = 20.

domains.title: Nonlinear algebra
domains.prep: Review exponents, factoring, and quadratic relationships.
domains.example: For x² - 9 = 0, add 9: x² = 9. Both 3 and -3 square to 9.

domains.title: Geometry and measurement
domains.prep: Review area, volume, and right triangles.
domains.example: A right triangle with legs 6 and 8 has c² = 6² + 8² = 100, so its hypotenuse is 10.

domains.title: Statistics and probability
domains.prep: Review center, spread, and simple probability.
domains.example: For data 2, 4, 9: mean = (2 + 4 + 9)/3 = 5; median = 4. These describe different aspects of the center.

items.prompt: Compute -6 + 9.

items.prompt: A recipe uses 2 cups of rice for 5 servings. How many cups for 15 servings?
items.explanation: 15 is three times 5, so multiply 2 by 3.
